acceptanceCriteria.description: Given boundaries/dependency-rules.json, When it is validated against dependency-rules.schema.json, Then a rule set declaring allowed and forbidden cross-module dependencies passes, and one naming a module absent from modules.json is rejected.
Given the schema, When a rule omits which modules it governs or what it permits, Then validation fails naming the missing field rather than accepting an unenforceable rule.

Given this repository's three modules, When a starter dependency-rules.json is written, Then it encodes the direction ADR-0006 states — @nit/skills may depend on @nit/cli, and neither may depend on @nit/workspace — and validates.
Given the new schema, When it is added, Then something reads every field it declares, proven by test (ADR-0007).
